name: Miko x Mono
source:
At summer vacations main character returns to his home town. He was abandoned at the shrine when he was young, so he returns to the Shinto priest family consisting of six people, or rather half-people partially dragon, snake or tengu. And relationship with these family members starts to change...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，主人公回到故乡。他年幼时曾被遗弃在神社，因此这次回到了神职人员一家身边。这个家庭共有六名成员，更准确地说，她们都是半人，有些带有龙、蛇或天狗的血统。主人公与这些家人之间的关系也开始发生变化…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
